messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging: error-rate spike on /v1/generate (us-west-2). 5xx rate 18% over last 3m, latency p95 4.2s. Auto-alert threshold breached.
oncall-sam: I'm on call. digging in. first step: check current capacity and any recent deploys. linking runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/high-5xx
samir: saw the spike too. recent model rollout 2026-03-15T03:10 (model v3-quant). I'm validating logs for OOMs.
samir: logs show repeated kv-cache misses and 'cuda out of memory' for shard 2. past 10m: ~120 OOM events.
priya: starting a controlled rollback to model v3-quant@20260314 to see if it stabilizes. I'll trigger canary rollback on prod-dedicated.
deploy-bot: Started rollback: deploy id dpl_9f3a - rolling back model on pool-prod-dedicated (canary 10% -> 100%).
samir: adding temporary rate-limiter at edge (/v1/generate) 50r/s to reduce churn.
oncall-sam: good. also enabling fallback to cpu-quant variant for small requests: routing policy updated.
alex: customer-impact estimate: ~12K requests failed in 18 minutes from 03:06-03:24. primary hits from region-us-west-2 and 2 top customers (cust-887, cust-224). I'll pull full counts and send later.
eng-manager-lisa: thanks. keep the incident channel updated. if rollback holds, plan postmortem and share timeline.
deploy-bot: Rollback complete. deploy id dpl_9f3a -> success. 100% traffic now on v3-quant@20260314.
oncall-sam: metrics look stable after rollback. 5xx dropped to <0.5% in 4m. keeping rate-limiter for next 30m.
incident-bot: Incident acknowledged by oncall-sam. Severity: P2. Auto-notify: #incidents, #customer-impact.
maria: opening a post-incident doc and scheduling follow-up. Proposed postmortem slot: Fri 2026-03-20 10:00 PT. :calendar: 
maria: Draft doc: https://redwood.docs/postmortems/INC-20260315-5xx-spike (please add notes and action items)
alex: I'll own the RCA writeup. plan: timeline + contributing factors + impact + remediation + follow-ups. Draft ETA: Mon 2026-03-17 EOD.
priya: I'll handle the 'runtime & kernel selection' section. want to include measurements: before/after kernel memory and shard distribution. Samir can add logs.
samir: attaching sample logs snippet for OOM pattern:
```
[E 03:07:12] shard-2 kernel: alloc 1.2GB failed - CUDA OOM
[E 03:07:12] kv-cache: miss key=abc123
[E 03:07:13] reload: trigger fallback to cpu-quant
```
priya: suggest we include config diff: the recent rollout changed allocator flag --block-gemm=false -> true and bumped batch size default.
alex: action items I'm putting in the doc:
- Alex: Draft RCA (timeline, impact numbers) by Mon EOD
- Priya: Kernel & allocator analysis by Tue 2026-03-18
- Samir: Verify telemetry for kv-cache misses and correlate with customer errors by Tue
- Maria: Schedule postmortem and send invites; coordinate with support for customer comms
- Ops: Add auto-detect for OOM spikes -> temporary traffic quarantine policy (owner: oncall)
- Eng-manager-lisa: Review and sign off RCA by Wed 2026-03-19
jordan: finance needs confirmed customer-impact numbers for billing/credits. tagging @billing-team.
maria: can we get a quick impact blurb for customers? alex, can you draft a 2-line summary after you have numbers?
alex: yes. tentative blurb: "We experienced elevated 5xx errors for ~18 minutes affecting a subset of requests in us-west-2; we've rolled back the recent model rollout and are continuing investigations. We'll follow up with a detailed postmortem and any remediation steps."
priya: for peer review, please focus on 'contributing factors' (allocator flags, kernel memory regressions, routing fallback). use comment threads on the doc link.
oncall-sam: keeping handoff notes: oncall -> evening-sre at 20:00 PT. current mitigations: rollback completed, rate-limiter in place, fallback enabled. no new alerts for 25m.
eng-manager-lisa: signoff criteria for RCA: clear timeline, root causes with evidence, verification steps for fixes, action owners + SLA for completion. please ping me when ready for review.
alex: posted initial skeleton in doc and added timeline entries. leaving TODOs where I need logs from Samir.
samir: added log excerpts and correlation table (kv-cache misses vs 5xx). noted a spike in shard-2 allocation failures.
maria: invite sent for postmortem Fri 10:00 PT; included SRE, Runtime, Product, Support, Billing.
incident-bot: Incident resolved (auto-check: 5xx < 1% for 30m). Marking incident as 'resolved' in the tracker.
alex: once I finish the draft I'll put the doc in 'rca/drafts' and add 'needs-review' tag. please use the 'RCA review checklist' in the doc.
priya: quick note — consider adding a canary guardrail: don't promote allocator changes without per-shard memory sim. adding as action item.
jordan: noted. billing will hold on credits until we get confirmed impacted request counts from Alex. thanks.
eng-manager-lisa: thanks everyone. good follow-through. :white_check_mark: let's keep momentum on action items and close them within the next sprint.
